baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb of benefit at word 5 governs the doubled ṣ-d-q nouns at words 6-7, making the truthful persons' own truthfulness the operative subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech that corresponds to reality and commitment that is fulfilled in action converge as durable congruence. The focus does not merely attach a reward to a truthful label; it presents that congruence itself as what becomes useful at the decisive moment.

activation_trace.role: Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the result function that truthfulness itself performs.
Correspondence of speech with inward state and reported reality supplies the baseline semantic core.
Fulfilment of promise and deed extends truth from accurate saying into enacted fidelity.

changed_reading.before: Truthful people receive a reward because they possess the moral label of truthfulness.
changed_reading.after: Their speech-action congruence is itself the benefit-bearing capacity that remains effective when claims are finally tested.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 9-16 join covered cultivation, running water, a lower channel, rivers, abiding, and unbounded duration.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reward is a maintained habitat rather than a static object. Shelter and cultivation occupy the visible level while water continually moves beneath it; abiding forever means the circulation does not exhaust or decay.

activation_trace.role: A tree-covered cultivated enclosure supplies the inhabited and sheltered upper layer.
Continuous movement of water supplies the habitat's active circulation.
The lower direction separates the sustaining flow from the inhabited surface while keeping them functionally joined.
A watercourse that cuts a channel through land supplies durable, abundant conveyance rather than pooled ornament.
Stable continuance resistant to decay makes the flowing habitat persist as a condition.
Unbounded duration removes any terminal horizon from that maintained condition.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises an eternal garden containing rivers.
changed_reading.after: It promises living permanence: a sheltered habitat whose sustaining circulation remains active without depletion or endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mirrored clauses at words 17-21 reverse the same relation, from God's acceptance of them to their acceptance of Him, before naming the great triumph.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammatical reversal and the reciprocal branch of r-ḍ-w make the outcome a settled two-sided relation. Triumph includes rescue and attainment, but its climax is relational concord rather than possession alone.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal acceptance supplies the bilateral mechanism made visible by the reversed clauses.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure supplies the settled state on both sides of the relation.
Rescue from harm together with attainment of good defines the concord as successful arrival.
Magnitude and force mark reciprocal settlement, not a subsidiary amenity, as the culminating success.

changed_reading.before: The great triumph is chiefly acquisition of the gardens.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are contained within a greater success: durable concord in which divine and human acceptance answer one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath passage sorts inconsequential speech from deliberately bound speech, then converts breach into feeding, clothing, or liberation and commands preservation of the oath. It therefore gives truthful commitment a material and social body: words can bind, fail, be repaired, and be guarded.

activation_trace.role: Speech discarded as not counting supplies the negative class against which consequential commitment is distinguished.
Ratifying and obligating a covenant supplies the bond that makes speech carry forward into action.
Giving food to another turns a failed verbal bond into concrete benefit for persons in need.
Providing clothing adds a second bodily form through which broken commitment is repaired.
Freedom opposed to bondage makes liberation the strongest social consequence assigned to verbal failure.
Guarding covenant and inviolability supplies ongoing maintenance of the bond after it is made.
Fulfilled promise and deed anchors the oath mechanism back in the focus's truthfulness.
Benefit names the eventual efficacy of a commitment whose integrity has been materially maintained.

structural_cues: 5:89 moves in sequence from idle utterance, to a deliberately bound oath, to bodily and social repair, and finally to guarding future oaths.
The focus repeats the agent and quality in the possessive construction: the truthful are benefited by their own truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech classification, a binding operation, and specified material repairs. I infer that these expose truthfulness as an obligation-bearing social bond; the live alternative is that 5:89 concerns only expiation and does not define the later ṣidq.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness is accurate speech rewarded in a separate domain.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness is kept or repaired fidelity whose words already organize material benefit, so its final usefulness completes a mechanism active within communal life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hunting test places desired prey within practical reach while the decisive restraint is fear in the unseen; the later reveal/conceal pair removes any assumption that hidden conduct remains hidden. Truthfulness is therefore congruence maintained when opportunity is present and external enforcement is absent.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes an inner condition appear supplies the disclosure mechanism.
The parallel mapped inventory likewise frames trial as the event through which a hidden state becomes observable.
Practical ability to reach and obtain the prey supplies real opportunity rather than hypothetical temptation.
Concealment from ordinary sight supplies the unpoliced setting in which integrity is tested.
What is brought into appearance supplies one side of the later knowledge contrast.
Deliberate concealment supplies the other side, showing that visibility does not delimit accountability.
Truth verified in deed anchors the hidden-test mechanism in the focus.

structural_cues: 5:94 juxtaposes reachable prey with fear exercised outside ordinary sight.
5:99 explicitly pairs what people display with what they conceal under divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies access, concealment, testing, and eventual knowledge. I infer that deed matching profession under low surveillance is a form of ṣidq; the live alternative is the narrower reading of these cues as game-law compliance only.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness primarily concerns statements made in public.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness is integrity across visible profession and hidden choice, and the final day makes that concealed congruence beneficial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witness procedure does not treat an oath as self-authenticating. Testimony can be challenged, hidden misconduct uncovered, entitlement established, a statement restored to its proper face, and prior oaths returned. This makes the focus day a final evidentiary review in which truth benefits because it remains coherent under reversal and replacement.

activation_trace.role: A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the evidentiary unit whose reliability is under review.
Discovery of what was hidden opens the procedure to correction rather than preserving first appearances.
Establishing and making truth manifest supplies the criterion for replacing compromised testimony.
The proper face or correct aspect of a matter supplies the target orientation for testimony.
Rejection of what fails acceptance supplies the procedural threat that disciplines the first witnesses.
Correspondence between declaration, inward state, and reality anchors procedural reliability in the focus.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 forms a complete review loop: initial testimony, discovery of disqualification, substitute witnesses, and possible return of the first oaths.
The legal sequence immediately precedes the eschatological sequence that begins with the gathering and questioning of messengers in 5:109.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adversarial correction procedure followed by a final gathering. I infer that the procedure prefigures how truth becomes useful at the focus day; the live alternative is that the legal and eschatological scenes are adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: The truthful are those whose first statement is accepted.
changed_reading.after: The truthful are those whose account remains aligned when evidence is exposed, standing is challenged, and testimony is reviewed from the other side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assurance that another person's deviation cannot harm the guided is followed by everyone's return, gathering, and disclosure of what each did. Against that sequence, the possessive 'their truthfulness' identifies a nontransferable moral capacity: collective return does not erase personal causation.

activation_trace.role: Harm as the direct contrary of benefit supplies the negative boundary around another person's deviation.
Return to the point of reckoning supplies the common destination without merging individual histories.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies collective presence at the same accounting.
A report brought and delivered supplies disclosure of each person's record.
Intentional deed supplies the individually attributable content that is disclosed.
Benefit answers the earlier exclusion of transferred harm.
Fulfilled deed makes the possessed truthfulness an attributable personal history rather than a group designation.

structural_cues: 5:105 combines immunity from another's deviation with a universal return and disclosure of deeds.
5:119 uses a possessive suffix: the benefit comes through the truthful persons' own truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transferred harm, common return, and individually reported deeds. I infer a matching non-transferred benefit in 5:119; the live alternative is that 5:105 offers pastoral reassurance without establishing an accountability model.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness benefits a class called the truthful.
changed_reading.after: Each person's enacted truth is the nontransferable bearer of benefit, even though all persons are gathered into one final scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messengers answer without claiming access to unseen reception; Jesus refuses a statement he had no right to make, distinguishes divine knowledge from his own, limits his witnessing to the period of his presence, and yields later surveillance to God. Truthfulness thus includes disciplined jurisdiction over what one can know, say, and attest.

activation_trace.role: A reply returned to a question supplies the formal demand for an account.
What is concealed from created sight marks the boundary the messengers do not cross in answering.
A claim fixed by reality and entitlement supplies the criterion for what the speaker may rightly say.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower differentiates divine access from the witness's limited access.
Presence with observation defines the temporal jurisdiction within which Jesus can bear witness.
Taking the soul closes the period of created presence and triggers the handoff of oversight.
Ongoing watchfulness supplies the divine oversight that continues after the human witness's departure.
Accurate correspondence anchors disciplined limits of testimony in the focus's truthfulness.

structural_cues: 5:109 opens the final inquiry with an answer that explicitly declines knowledge.
5:116-117 repeatedly delimit saying, knowing, witnessing, and watching before 5:119 announces the benefit of truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit boundaries of knowledge, entitlement, presence, and oversight. I infer that respecting those boundaries is the operative form of truthfulness; the live alternative is that the dialogue is only exculpatory and does not generalize an epistemic discipline.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness means supplying all accurate information one can state.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness also means refusing unsupported knowledge and confining testimony to one's actual right, access, and period of witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disciples seek edible evidence to calm their hearts, confirm truthful speech, and establish witness; the request then names the table as a sign and provision. At the focus, that dependency reverses: no external object verifies truth, because the truthful persons' own truthfulness becomes beneficial and opens into an enduring habitat.

activation_trace.role: Inner stillness supplies the affective result expected from receiving tangible evidence.
Speech matching reality supplies the claim that the requested object is meant to verify.
Presence with direct observation supplies the desired transition from hearers to witnesses.
A food-bearing table supplies the concrete object around which verification is requested.
Feeding, benefit, and gift expose the table's function as provision rather than proof alone.
A manifest sign supplies the external mark expected to settle the claim.
Allocated gift supplies the provisioning frame attached to the requested sign.
Benefit shifts from the sign consumed by witnesses to truthfulness possessed by the truthful.
The cultivated habitat enlarges one-time food provision into a durable place of life.

structural_cues: 5:113 states a chain from eating, to calm, to confirmation of truth, to witness.
5:114 recasts the requested object as feast, sign, and provision; 5:115 makes denial after that sign exceptionally consequential.
5:119 makes truthfulness itself the grammatical source of benefit before naming the garden habitat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external proof-provision and later truth-as-benefit. I infer a reversal from truth needing a consumed sign to truth itself provisioning the truthful; the live alternative is that the table episode and garden verdict are sequential but not deliberately contrastive.

changed_reading.before: Truth needs an external sign to become credible, and provision confirms the speaker.
changed_reading.after: At final disclosure, enacted truth no longer borrows credibility from provision; it becomes the benefit-bearing reality through which lasting provision is entered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, punishment and protective forgiveness remain live alternatives under might and wise judgment. The focus then replaces the unresolved conditional with mutual acceptance, and the following verse grounds that settlement in encompassing sovereignty and effective power. Pleasure here functions as an adjudicated, enforceable relation rather than a passing emotion.

activation_trace.role: Pain imposed as penalty supplies one live judicial outcome immediately before the verdict.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer from the fault's effect supplies the alternative merciful outcome.
Prevailing power supplies authority capable of carrying either outcome into effect.
Judgment informed by fitting knowledge supplies the discriminating quality of the decision.
Mutual acceptance supplies the resolved relation that follows the open alternatives.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure marks the verdict as closure of exposure to adverse judgment.
Rescue and attainment identify the settled relation as the comprehensive successful outcome.
Sovereign dominion supplies the jurisdiction within which the verdict is final.
Effective capacity that reaches action supplies enforceability for the permanent settlement.

structural_cues: 5:118 leaves punishment and forgiveness in conditional parallel; 5:119 answers with an unconditioned declaration of mutual acceptance.
5:120 closes the pericope by assigning all dominion and effective capacity to the judge who issued that declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies live judicial alternatives, mutual acceptance, and sovereign capacity. I infer that the acceptance is an enforceable settlement produced by judgment; the live alternative is to read it as affective pleasure without procedural force.

changed_reading.before: God's pleasure and their pleasure describe happiness added to the reward.
changed_reading.after: Their reciprocal acceptance is the final legal-relational settlement, secured by the sovereign power that makes the garden's permanence reliable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-spatial motif, not a lexical equation: a one-time food-bearing sign descends from above in 5:114, while sustaining waters run below an inhabited garden in 5:119. It remains valid because descent, sky, table, provision, lower direction, flow, and river are all explicit anchors. Downstream prose should present it as a possible transformation in the geometry of provision, not as the verse's settled meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus explicitly locates active river flow below the cultivated habitat.

activation_trace.role: Delivery by downward movement supplies the vertical path of the exceptional sign.
The food-bearing table supplies the bounded object delivered along that path.
The overhanging upper realm supplies the table's stated origin.
Allocated gift identifies the descending object as provision.
Ongoing water movement replaces the episodic delivery with continuous circulation.
The explicitly lower location reverses the direction from provision arriving above to provision coursing below.
A land-cutting watercourse enlarges a bounded meal into habitat-scale conveyance.

changed_reading.before: The descending table and the garden rivers are separate images of divine gift.
changed_reading.after: The sequence may transform provision from an exceptional object descending for verification into perpetual circulation beneath a habitat where verification is complete.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading treats the garden's covering and shielding branches as a functional analogy with the pericope's guarded and inviolable spaces. It is surprising because the surface noun conventionally denotes a garden, not a legal precinct; it remains anchored in the focus inventory and in 5:96-97's protection, sacred boundary, and social support. Downstream prose should call it a protected-habitat resonance, not redefine the garden as a sanctuary law.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garden noun at word 9 carries covering, cultivated enclosure, and protective-shield branches while flow continues inside its bounds.

activation_trace.role: Protection that pushes harm away supplies the active maintenance required by a safeguarded domain.
A bounded sacred domain supplies the spatial analogy for protected habitation.
Inviolability and protected right supply the social force of that boundary.
A supporting means of subsistence makes the protected place an infrastructure for communal life.
Covering from perception supplies the garden's enclosing function.
Tree-covered cultivation keeps the enclosure an inhabited garden rather than an abstract boundary.
A protective shield supplies the branch-distant but focus-anchored resonance of safety.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are luxuriant scenery awarded after judgment.
changed_reading.after: They may also resonate as safeguarded habitats whose enclosure preserves lawful benefit, social stability, and living flow.

strongest_changes: The oath sequence turns truth from accurate wording into a materially binding fidelity whose breach and repair affect bodies and social freedom.
The hidden hunting test and the witness-review procedure turn truth into integrity that remains coherent under low surveillance and later challenge.
The table episode reverses from provision used to verify truth to truthfulness itself becoming the benefit-bearing route into enduring provision.
The final punishment-forgiveness alternative makes mutual acceptance an adjudicated and sovereignly enforceable settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled truth root and active benefit verb were activated by oath repair, concealed conduct, adversarial testimony, bounded knowledge, requested proof-provision, and the final judicial dialogue. Together they move the focus from a reward slogan to several inspectable mechanisms by which truth carries material, epistemic, legal, and relational force.
remaining_uncertainties: The table-to-underflow geometry is textually anchored but may be narrative resonance rather than a designed reversal.
The protected-habitat reading should not import sanctuary law into the garden noun beyond its covering and shielding branches.
The mirrored acceptance remains reciprocal in syntax while divine and human acceptance are not necessarily symmetrical in agency or scope.
